description: global_config.getEdgeConfigTokens (GET /v1/global-config/{edgeConfigId}/tokens) documents the 200 response as a single EdgeConfigToken object, but the live API returns a JSON array of them (same class of spec bug as getEdgeConfigs). Wrap the response schema in an array so GetEdgeConfigTokensResponse types as the list the API actually returns; needed to enumerate a config's tokens (e.g. test-side leak verification).
